name: orchestra
description: Multi-session agent orchestration for Claude Code: one orchestrator session, parallel workstream sessions, spec-first, risk-proportional reviews. Also lists the third-party plugins the workflow uses, fetched from their own upstream repositories.

plugins.name: orchestra
plugins.description: Orchestrator and workstream roles, 9 subagents, handoff notes, per-workstream test databases, and /orchestra:init to scaffold a project.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Upstream: Jesse Vincent (obra/superpowers). Brainstorming, plans, subagent-driven development, TDD, debugging, code review.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Upstream: Dietrich Gebert (DietrichGebert/ponytail). Lazy senior dev mode with off, lite, full and ultra levels, plus review, debt and audit.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Upstream: Paul Bakaus (pbakaus/impeccable). Frontend design fluency, anti-pattern detector and finish reviewer.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Upstream: leonxlnx (Leonxlnx/taste-skill). Art direction to keep mockups clear of the generic AI look.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Upstream: Anthropic (claude-plugins-official). Distinctive visual direction for mockups.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Upstream: Anthropic (knowledge-work-plugins). Design critique and accessibility review.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Upstream: Cloudflare (cloudflare/security-audit-skill). Multi-phase security audits with independently verified findings.

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Upstream: Microsoft (microsoft/playwright-cli). Browser checks and screenshots from the command line. Needs the CLI: npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest.
